title: Bluegill Triple Prime as missile defense, tied to SDI
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bluegill Triple Prime as missile defense, tied to SDI, about 1962 at Pacific (high-altitude nuclear test), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
Yeah, and that that in fact the Bluegill
Triple Prime thing was
it was a high-altitude nuclear test, but
it was a defense against Russian ICBMs

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels repeats what a man named Malmgren told him about Bluegill Triple Prime, a high-altitude nuclear test over the Pacific in 1962. According to Michels, Malmgren said the test was really a defense against Russian long-range nuclear missiles, and he points to a paper from the RAND Corporation, a US defense research group, and to the Institute for Defense Analysis. The story links it to the Strategic Defense Initiative, a later US plan to shield the country from missiles, which would make the test an early missile shield if true.
